body:
# Spiders Make Webs

### Overview

SpidersMakeWebs is a Minecraft Forge mod that enhances spider behavior by allowing them to create cobwebs in the world. This mod introduces new AI goals for spiders, enabling them to generate cobwebs and web patterns dynamically.

## Spiders randomly place cobwebs
